facts.recommendationText: Implement waitlist system to manage demand Reduce customer frustration by setting expectations and freeing capacity for retention While turnaround time remains high, a waitlist prevents customer abandonment Immediate relief for customer experience while longer-term capacity fix is designed Create customer communication explaining wait time and providing estimated completion date Template tested with 3 customers, feedback incorporated Use spreadsheet or simple tool to track order position and manage customer expectations All customer orders tracked, completion estimates accurate within 10% Collect feedback on waitlist experience via follow-up call or survey Satisfaction score improves to 7+/10, repeat customer inquiry rate increases
